_about: The Flow runner Chrome extension. Its working copy (the master, loaded in Chrome) is in the LOCKED OUT folder on the first Mac. `sync` copies its code here whenever that folder is reachable, so the brain always carries the current extension. The jobs folder (the movie's frames, cast pictures and prompts) is never copied: each computer builds it from its own movie folder.
The Firefly runner Chrome extension (Kling video and, since 17 Nov 2026, images: text to image and image to image). Working copy in the LOCKED OUT folder; the jobs folder is built per computer.
